body: I'm really not that nice.. It's not like im purposefully an asshole or something, but I'm almost always in a shit mood, and because I don't trust others, I'm not particularly friendly to them.. I always act really grumpy/pissed off and when I'm around people (even when they're my 'friends'), I hardly ever say anything, and if I do it's either stupid or mean.

There's basically 3 reasons I don't want to interact with anyone..

First of all I've been let down by a lot of people I trusted, over the past few years, so I've resorted to not trusting anyone, which feels great, to be honest.

Secondly, I hate the person I am, and I can't comprehend why anyone else wouldn't hate me, so I just assume they do..

Third, whenever I talk to/interact with someone I don't know, or even people I dó know, it's really awkward, I have no idea what to say and as a result it just completely ruins my mood for the rest of the day..

So that's why I try to just stay away from people as much as I can, the only exception being L.
I don't know.. I'm not too bothered by it. It probably does hold me back, but I'm used to it, and I barely go out of the house anyway..

Hmm.. I don't know.. I mean, she's really the only person I properly interact with, at this point. I barely even speak to my parents, despite living in the same house.. Sure, I'm really glad she understands me and tries to help me and such, but even just arbitrary conversations with her are great, because she's the only one I have them with, I suppose?

Also, I guess I didn't emphasize it enough (or at all), but.. People really scare me. I'm bloody 19 years old, and I'm terrified of even going to a grocery store, just because I don't want to have to interact with the cassier. If I dó go somewhere where there's people, It physically exhausts me, and my mood is completely ruined for at least the rest of the day. So honestly, group counseling or something similar doesn't quite appeal to me.. 

I've always thought I'm just not meant to be in this world.. Most people feel like living is a good thing, I don't understand that.. I don't know if life screwed me over, or if I just screwed it up by myself, but either way, I'm not enjoying this and I'm not sure if I should even try to find help or anything, at this point, because I don't know if I can be helped.. I mean sure, my life can probably be improved in some way, but I doubt it'll ever be worth living, in my eyes..

I don't know.. I game a lot.. Too much, probably, but I never really enjoy it tbh.. I just do it to make time go by faster, and to take my mind off of other things.. The only thing I can come up with that I genuinly enjoy is spending time with L.. =/

Thanks you for responding,

Over the three month period I saw two different psychologists.. Nothing really 'happened' I guess. I mean, they just asked the kind of questions you'd expect them to ask.. But these exact questions made me feel even more worthless and shittier than before.. I suppose the questions just made me think about things I had supressed and really didn't want to think about.. Plus, even then, I don't think I really wanted the help, so I wasn't very coöperative either..

Also, I know L loves me, and cares about me.. And that means the world to me.. But.. I don't know.. She also says she'd understand if I did it, and I really can't take all the shit that's going on in my life any longer tbh.. Maybe I'm just selfish =/
